missing: What counts as a Deploy. There are three troop landings with three different rule sets. An event card's Deploy line gets +1 troop from level 2 and is stopped by a Deploy prohibition (adversary.rs:331-355 standing(); team.rs:29-31 deploy only when label=='standing'). The Protector landing gets neither, even though the draft says it lands 'as in Deploy' (adversary.rs:1069 passes deploy=false). A project's 'Deploy 3' (Armored Columns, Declaration of War) also gets neither. Rally and Corrupt prohibitions, by contrast, do catch project lines in that turn (adversary.rs rally(); plan.rs corrupt_plan_blocked). Demilitarized Zone prints 'no troop is deployed', which reads as covering all three. Proposal: a prohibition stops every landing of its kind that turn, and the difficulty +1 applies to every Deploy (or the cards print 'event Deploy').

A blocked site has opposite results depending on the blocker. Wall sends a Deploy troop on to the next factory, but a Deploy prohibition keeps it in the supply, because the spot is picked first and then checked (adversary.rs:1318-1335). A firewall spreads a Rally share over the other sites (plan.rs rally_sites), but a Rally prohibition keeps the share in the supply (adversary.rs:996-1009). Add this to #9 or as its own entry. Proposal: one rule, either a blocked share always stays in the supply or it always moves on.

Projects resolve outside the adversary's turn. gain_compute resolves a project the moment it fills (adversary.rs:788-812), and compute arrives in production (production.rs:400 corrupted stations, :455 agents on bare node hexes) and in step F (unpaid threats). So Grand Offensive, Infiltration Drive, Botnet Swarm and Station Coup can rally, corrupt or flip in the middle of production, though the round table puts Rally and Corrupt in step B. Proposal: compute waits until step B, or a project resolves at the next step 7.

Land corruption doesn't stop building. free_zones (common.rs:154) and buildable/station_sites ignore the land-corruption token. A city can grow a factory on a corrupted zone, and a player can build a research station there, though no node may be placed on it (node.rs:39). The draft is silent. Proposal: land corruption forbids buildings too, or the draft says it doesn't.
suspect: Section 21, '+1 troop on each Deploy line': the engine adds it only to the event card's each-country troop lines (adversary.rs:331-355; content/adversary.json:48 says 'each event's Deploy'). Project Deploys and the Protector landing get no +1. Fix: 'each event card's Deploy line'.

Section 6 step 6 ('lands as in Deploy') with section 12 ('forbid the adversary's next ... Deploy') implies a Deploy prohibition stops the Protector landing. It doesn't (adversary.rs:1069, deploy=false), and it doesn't stop a project's Deploy 3 either (team.rs:30).
